config.candidate_order: core eager query().candidates.items; no frontend reorder
deviations: Xiaohe instead of default full pinyin
No translators/glossaries, cloud, neural models or downloads
No personal learner, usage/vocabulary/panel meters, input logging, system text replacements or custom phrases
No native host/front-end layout, paging, highlight movement, aux-code or punctuation UI; only requested ASCII subset + Return
Ten core candidates exposed in stable order, independent of native page size
config.frontend: dispatch ASCII to push/backspace/clear/commit/take_raw; retain visible candidate objects; core owns buffer and held
config.learning_control: Engine::set_learning(false) + default NoLearner; no personal state loaded
config.load_boundary: data open/mmap/validation, english+emoji parse and Engine assembly through configuration; excludes process startup and JSON
config.preedit_fallback: parse error: core held_text + actual composition.text
config.reset: clear + break_chain + enter_input_box; static data not reloaded
config.timing: process includes key/state mutation and query/sort; collect includes top-ten materialization+copy and marked/state extraction; excludes JSON and IPC
config.user_state: none: no installed Qingjian paths read or written

All smoke timing is correctness evidence only; no formal performance sampling.

adjustments: Only isolated Fcitx5Utils target and its subdirectory are built/installed; no input method registration.

libime ENABLE_DATA=OFF avoids unrelated table downloads; build only pinyin/core and two data tools.
Factory data converted using exact upstream commands (-s -a 22 -q 4 trie); no data substitution.
API defaults retained except Xiaohe/useShuangpin/Pinyin preedit; no frontend fuzzy/correction settings added.
No user dict/history is loaded or saved; learn is never called; no personal paths consulted.
Only 10 candidates copied in engine order; partial selections remain composing until fully selected.
All smoke timing is correctness evidence only; no formal performance sampling.
